snip.t: The ankle joint is primarily a hinge joint (dorsiflexion/plantarflexion), doesn't communicate with the subtalar joint, and dorsiflexion is accompanied by slight abduction/eversion at the subtalar joint.
snip.s: Anatomy Must-Know — Lower Limb MCQs, Section 3 (Part 3 of 4)
